_description: Dated, read-only freezes of countries.json. Never edit a snapshot in place — trend history cannot be backfilled.

_date_semantics.frozen_at: When this snapshot file was written. Says nothing about how current the data is.
_date_semantics.data_collected: When the research pass that produced these values was carried out.
_date_semantics.reporting_period: The period the underlying indicators actually describe. This is the date that matters for accuracy claims.

snapshots.note: Freezes the v1 baseline before the 2026-08 data refresh. Values are NOT current as of frozen_at — they come from the March 2026 collection, and most underlying indicators (data-centre capacity, load-shedding stages, penetration rates) describe 2024-2025 reporting periods. Do not present these figures as today's state of the market.
